what: Per 2026 bf16 open model: the weights the glyd vLLM plugin (private/main glyd-gpu-py/glyd_gpu/vllm_plugin.py) packs under vLLM 0.30.0 and the ones it leaves unpacked, with bytes. Desk inventory from safetensors headers read by HTTP range and vLLM 0.30.0's model source; nothing run.

method.bytes: checkpoint bytes (GB = 1e9) from each safetensors header; 'loaded by vLLM' drops what vLLM 0.30.0's model file maps to None or skips (MTP / nextn layers, Gemma 4's KV-shared k/v)
method.packed: GlydConfig.get_quant_method: a LinearBase built with the quant config of >= 1<<20 weights (vLLM's merged layer: q/k/v, gate/up, in_proj_qkv/z, b/a, MLA q_a/kv_a summed), rows % 64 == 0, columns % 16 == 0, bf16; RoutedExperts: SiLU, no bias, no expert parallel, H % 64, 2I % 128, I % 16; VocabParallelEmbedding / ParallelLMHead (exact types) built with the quant config: dim % 64, >= 4096 rows, head_dtype bf16. Layout rule on an RTX 4090/5090 (on an A100/H100 a MoE model's attention Linears stay bf16: dense_stays)
method.projections: PROJECTED, not measured: saving = packed bytes x (1 - bits/16) / bytes vLLM loads; tiered 10.80 bits a weight, 12-bit 12.04. Ceilings with everything packed: 32.5% / 24.75%
method.check: Qwen3.5-9B: 17.53 GiB loaded (18.83 GB), 15.36 GiB of it packed -> 12.54 GiB tiered + 0.13 GiB vLLM's own buffers (bf16's measured 17.66 GiB less 17.53 checkpoint GiB) = 12.67 GiB against 12.68 GiB measured (RTX 4090, v0.29, 2026-10-05); 12-bit: 13.86 against 13.89 GiB measured (RTX 5090). The alternatives (embedding packed: 12.05; vision tower unpacked: 12.86) do not match.
